# Repository instructions

Read the final SSOT, `AGENTS.md`, every required accepted ADR, the accepted owning PRD, and the exact accepted atomic ticket in full. All active ADRs, PRDs, and tickets are currently proposed/blocked; do not write product code until their separate gates pass. Never edit beyond exact file/symbol ownership or begin a dependent ticket while a predecessor is failed, blocked, partial, stale, or unverified.
